'''Donnal Cuciv''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wukkar/Legends|Wukkar]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Cuciv was elderly and he worked at [[Iltarr City Spaceport]] on Wukkar, where he was responsible for maintaining the [[Spaceport/Legends|port's]] incoming passenger and [[Starship/Legends|shipping]] lists. Around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Cuciv became a blackmail victim of the crime syndicate [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] and he visited [[Black Sun sector chief|Black Sun sector Chief]] [[Avrak Villachor]] at Villachor's [[Marblewood Estate]] on Wukkar. Cuciv was spotted by the [[Wukkar aristocracy|aristocrat]] [[Rachele Ree]] entering the estate and he was subsequently consulted by a group of criminals led by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], who sought to gain a description of Villachor's blackmail [[Datacard/Legends|datacards]] in preparation for a [[Marblewood Estate heist|heist]] that they planned to stage at the estate. The [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] operative [[Dayja/Legends|Dayja]] also sort out Cuciv to learn details of the blackmail files and then drugged Cuciv with the substance [[Speakeasy]] in order to make him forget their encounter.<ref name="Scoundrels" />
